ReferenceImage

class ReferenceImage[source]

Class representing a reference FITS image.

Inherits from BaseImage and provides methods for managing reference image metadata, processing status tracking, and handling associated products like background maps, error maps, masks, and source catalogs.

Parameters:

  • path (str or Path) – Path to the reference FITS image.

  • telinfo (dict, optional) – Telescope metadata dictionary.

  • status (Status, optional) – Initial status object. If not provided, status is loaded from file or initialized.

  • load (bool, optional) – Whether to load status and header upon initialization.

__init__(path, telinfo=None, status=None, load=True)[source]

Methods

Visualize the FITS image with optional WCS overlay and downsampling.

Parameters:

None

Return type:

None

show_position(self, x, y, coord_type='pixel', downsample=4, zoom_radius_pixel=100, cmap='gray', scale='zscale', figsize=(6, 6), ax=None, save_path=None, title=True)

Display a zoomed-in view around a given (x, y) or (RA, Dec) position.

Parameters:

  • x (float) – X-coordinate (pixel or RA)

  • y (float) – Y-coordinate (pixel or Dec)

  • coord_type (str, optional) – ‘pixel’ or ‘coord’. Default is ‘pixel’.

  • downsample (int, optional) – Step size for downsampling via slicing. Default is 4.

  • zoom_radius_pixel (int, optional) – Radius of the zoom-in region in pixels. Default is 100.

  • cmap (str, optional) – Matplotlib colormap. Default is ‘gray’.

  • scale (str, optional) – Scaling method. Default is ‘zscale’.

  • figsize (tuple, optional) – Matplotlib figure size. Default is (6, 6).

  • ax (matplotlib Axes object, optional) – If provided, the image will be plotted on this axis. Default is None.

  • save_path (str, optional) – Path to save the figure. Default is None.

  • title (bool, optional) – Whether to display the title. Default is True.

Remove the main FITS file and/or associated connected files.

Parameters:

  • remove_main (bool) – If True, remove the main FITS file (self.path)

  • remove_connected_files (bool) – If True, remove associated files (status, mask, coadd, etc.)

  • skip_exts (list) – List of file extensions to skip (e.g. [‘.png’, ‘.cat’])

  • verbose (bool) – If True, print removal results

Returns:
